dz: 美利坚合众国第十二任总统扎卡里·泰勒和第十二任副总统米勒德·菲尔莫尔没有宣誓就职（他们是在第二天宣誓的），导致人们错误地认为即将离任的美国参议院临时议长戴维·赖斯·艾奇森已代理一天总统。
de: Zachary Taylor, 12th President of the United States of America and Millard Fillmore, 12th Vice President, did not take their respective oaths of office (they did so the following day), leading to the erroneous theory that outgoing President pro tempore of the United States Senate David Rice Atchison had assumed the role of acting president for one day.

t: 卡罗·阿尔贝托·迪·萨沃亚(Carlo Alberto di Savoia)签署"斯塔图多·阿…

de: Carlo Alberto di Savoia signs the Statuto Albertino that will later represent the first constitution of the Regno d'Italia.

dz: 芝加哥市成立。
de: The city of Chicago is incorporated.

dz: 1812 年战争：美国人在安大略省伦敦和泰晤士维尔（位于今安大略省沃兹维尔附近）之间的朗伍德战役中击败了英国军队。
de: War of 1812: Americans defeat British forces at the Battle of Longwoods between London, Ontario and Thamesville, near present-day Wardsville, Ontario.

te: John Adams is inaugurated as the 2nd President of the United States of America, becoming the first President to begin h…
dz: 约翰·亚当斯就任美利坚合众国第二任总统，成为第一位于 3 月 4 日开始就职的总统。
de: John Adams is inaugurated as the 2nd President of the United States of America, becoming the first President to begin his presidency on March 4.

t: 美国宪法第11修正案由美国国会通过.
te: The 11th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution is passed by the U.S. Congress.
dz: 美国宪法第11修正案由美国国会通过.
de: The 11th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution is passed by the U.S. Congress.

dz: 佛蒙特州成为美国第十四个州。
de: Vermont is admitted to the United States as the fourteenth state.

dz: 法国被划分为83个省,跨越了前几省,试图以贵族对地的所有权为基础,将地区忠诚驱离.
de: France is divided into 83 départements, cutting across the former provinces in an attempt to dislodge regional loyalties based on ownership of land by the nobility.

t: 在纽约市,美国第一届国会相会,使"美国宪法"生效.
te: In New York City, the first Congress of the United States meets, putting the United States Constitution into effect.
dz: 在纽约市,美国第一届国会相会,使"美国宪法"生效.
de: In New York City, the first Congress of the United States meets, putting the United States Constitution into effect.

de: American Revolutionary War: The Continental Army fortifies Dorchester Heights with cannon, leading the British troops to abandon the Siege of Boston.

dz: 约翰·弗拉姆斯泰德被任命为第一位英国皇家天文学家.

te: Explorer Christopher Columbus arrives back in Lisbon, Portugal, aboard his ship Niña from his voyage to what are now Th…
dz: 探险家克里斯托弗·哥伦布 (Christopher Columbus) 登上他的尼娜号 (Niña) 船，返回葡萄牙里斯本，结束了对现在的巴哈马群岛和加勒比海其他岛屿的航行。
de: Explorer Christopher Columbus arrives back in Lisbon, Portugal, aboard his ship Niña from his voyage to what are now The Bahamas and other islands in the Caribbean.

de: Wars of the Roses in England: Lancastrian King Henry VI is deposed by his House of York cousin, who then becomes King Edward IV.

te: Martyrdom of Saint Adrian of Nicomedia.

dz: 尼禄后来成为了罗马皇帝,被授予了"王子"(Principles iuventutis)(青年之首)的称号.
